text:
alex.k: Heads-up — nightly CI red on hosted-integ (shard 61). Failing auth handshakes and a few toolcall timeouts, seen a cluster of 401s + intermittent 502s. Can someone grab a rerun?

maria-s: I noticed an uptick in auth-proxy 502s in the last 10m, maybe upstream JWKS fetches flapping under concurrency. throwing my thumb on it now.

samir: tagging @maria-s — if it’s JWKS/rotation we should try a targeted rerun of shard 61 with reduced concurrency to confirm. I can schedule a rerun if y'all agree.

alex.k: please queue the rerun. put it on shard 61 only; keep logs verbose (`CI_VERBOSITY=debug`). also include `KID_CACHE_TTL=30s` override just to test whether cache TTL is involved.

ci-bot: queued rerun for pipeline hosted-integ shard=61, run_id=ci-3067891234-1. priority=high. ETA ~3m.

samir: rerun started. quick note: before we had lots of `401 token_signature_invalid` lines, now seeing `502 auth-proxy -> jwks fetch 504` during the handshake window.

maria-s: ok that matches what I saw — JWKS endpoint was returning 503 spikes. I'm throwing a short retry patch on auth-proxy to backoff-jwks for 2s/6s and re-running a couple of manual calls to validate.

oncall-bot: rerun ci-3067891234-1 finished: result=partial-failure. tests that exercise streaming+toolcall show 3 failing cases. full logs: https://ci.redwood.test/runs/ci-3067891234-1/logs

alex.k: thanks. can someone paste the failing test names? we need to decide if this is flaky infra or a real regression.

samir: failing tests: `test_streaming_tool_call_ordering`, `test_session_handshake_retry`, `test_tool_response_schema_mismatch` — two look timing-related, one looks like a strict schema check failing (tool returned extra `meta` field).

maria-s: the schema mismatch might be downstream from partial tool retries — if toolcall retries return both old and new envelopes we could see extra `meta` appended. I'll instrument the tool-proxy to log envelope variants on next run.

alex.k: can we try a bisect? If infra changes in last 24h include JWKS backoff + a small runtime tweak, try disabling the JWKS retry patch in a short-run to isolate.

samir: scheduling a quick bisect run: two jobs — (A) revert JWKS retry patch + run shard61; (B) keep patch + reduce concurrency. launching both now.

ci-bot: bisect jobs queued: bisect-A=ci-3067891234-a, bisect-B=ci-3067891234-b. links: https://ci.redwood.test/bisect/3067891234

oncall-bot: update: bisect-A failed same three tests. bisect-B passed streaming tests but still failed `test_tool_response_schema_mismatch`.

alex.k: interesting — that suggests JWKS fix helped streaming timing but schema failure persists. maria, samir — can you run a quick local repro of the toolcall with the failing fixture and capture raw HTTP responses? put them in the bisect ticket.

maria-s: on it. I’ll attach raw responses and a small harness by EOD. initial glance: tool-proxy sometimes adds `meta` when retrying, bug in merge logic.

samir: thanks. if that’s the root cause we should hotfix tool-proxy merge logic rather than altering retries. I’ll keep the JWKS backoff in place for now.

alex.k: plan sounds good. action items: maria -> raw responses + harness; samir -> PR for merge fix + test; I'll monitor nightly and remove the JWKS override once infra is stable.

maria-s: noted. adding tasks to the ticket. :white_check_mark:

samir: marking as triaged. will ping here when PR is ready for review.

alex.k: appreciate the quick coordination.
